_readme: Allow-list for scripts/check-dead-code.mjs (gate G2). An entry means the function has no production caller in the final schema, src/data, supabase/functions, the RPC catalogue or a migration statement, and is deliberately kept. Every entry must carry a real reason. Per docs/BRANCH-MAP.md a function that a SQL test calls is NOT dead code (it is a tested unit the UI has not reached yet) and must not be deleted to lower a count. Do not add an entry to silence a genuinely dead function; delete it or wire it.
_test-only: Called by a named SQL test. docs/BRANCH-MAP.md: a test-only function is a tested unit, not dead code. The tests run twice in the Docker harness.
_platform-operational: An operational or server-side RPC whose caller is outside this repository (pg_cron job, Supabase auth hook, hosting-migration runner, anchoring worker). It is reachable in production but not from any file the gate can read.
_unreferenced: No caller in the schema, the app, an Edge Function, a migration statement or any SQL test. Recorded as a real finding rather than deleted, because docs/BRANCH-MAP.md forbids silently deleting another area's code. Each states the superseding code path.

admin_set_engagement_gate.reason: Platform writer for engagement_gate_settings; pinned by the deployment-gate tests.

admin_set_entity_approval.reason: Writes entity_approval_settings.required_fields, enforced by submit_entity (Phase 3.6); pinned by test 110 §2.

admin_set_org_setting.reason: Generic org-setting writer; pinned by the admin-RPC tests.

admin_set_org_settings_extra.reason: Writes org_settings_extra (certificate_auto_issue, last_board_meeting_date), enforced by seal_engagement and board_pack_generate (Phase 3.6).

anchoring_status.reason: Reads a subject's anchor/signature status; pinned by the integrity-anchoring tests.

approval_step_decide.reason: Records one approval_chain step; consumed by approve_plan (Phase 2.4) and pinned by test 102.

assign_team_role.reason: Assigns an engagement team role; pinned by the team-role tests.

check_readability.reason: Deterministic observation completeness check; used by alert_raise_finding (C5) and pinned by tests 39 and 115.

connector_run_finish.reason: Closes a connector run; pinned by the connectors-monitoring tests.

connector_run_start.reason: Opens a connector run; pinned by the connectors-monitoring tests.

cycle_summary.reason: Inherent-risk environment per entity and universe; pinned by the SIRA-cycle tests.

deployment_request_status.reason: Explains a combined-deployment request's readiness; pinned by test 30.

email_dispatch_set_token.reason: Stores the dispatcher token; the email-dispatch schedule reads it, and the tests pin it.

ledger_copy_mode_ok.reason: Guard the ledger chain trigger consults; pinned by test 78.

phrase_create.reason: Creates a draft phrase; pinned by the phrase-library tests. Only phrase_list is reached from the UI today.

population_archive_check.reason: Verifies one archived page's hash; pinned by the verified-archival tests.

population_archive_page.reason: Pages an archived population; pinned by the verified-archival tests.

population_archive_verify.reason: Verifies an archived population's chain; pinned by the verified-archival tests.

remove_conclusion_exception.reason: Removes a conclusion exception with a reason; pinned by the conclusion tests.

role_effective_has_right.reason: The scoped rights predicate: a person's effective rights at an engagement from the nearest scoped role grant. Pinned by test 143 §6; the screen reads the same answer through role_effective.

scheduled_export_due.reason: Turns export_retention_settings.export_schedule into a decision (Phase 3.6); pinned by test 110 §4b.

select_sira_risk.reason: Records that a library risk applies to an entity; pinned by the SIRA-model tests.

signature_record.reason: Records a signature; pinned by the integrity-anchoring tests. The anchoring flow writes it server-side.

signatures_get.reason: Reads a subject's signatures; pinned by the integrity-anchoring tests.

staged_record_ingest.reason: Idempotent staged-record insert; the monitor runner (C1) and the connector tests drive it.

timestamp_fail.reason: Records a failed timestamp attempt; pinned by the integrity-anchoring tests.

timestamp_queue.reason: Queues a timestamp request; pinned by the integrity-anchoring tests.

timestamp_record.reason: Records a timestamp receipt; pinned by the integrity-anchoring tests.

verify_monitor_chain.reason: Verifies an org's monitor-alert hash chain; pinned by the Phase 5 tests.

default_signing_algorithm.reason: Reads the active default signing algorithm from signing_algorithms (0205 WP16); pinned by test 150. The rotate/anchor path currently names its algorithm explicitly, so this reader has no schema caller yet.

platform_create_group.reason: Platform owner creates an org group (0206 §1). Pinned by the scale-isolation and group/joint-audit tests; the Super Admin group-management screen is not built yet.

platform_link_org.reason: Platform owner links an org to a group (0206 §1). Pinned by the scale-isolation and group/joint-audit tests; no screen offers it yet.

platform_unlink_org.reason: Platform owner removes an org's group association (0206 §1). Pinned by the group/joint-audit test; no screen offers it yet.

platform_list_associations.reason: Platform owner lists group associations (0206 §1). Pinned by the group/joint-audit test; no screen offers it yet.

has_org.reason: Identity helper (0007) superseded by an inline `jwt_org_id() is not null` check; no caller in schema, app, migrations or tests. Retained rather than deleted per BRANCH-MAP (not this area's code to remove); reported in docs/SCALE-TASKS.md.

org_id_from_header.reason: Defensive helper (0009) that proves the org is read from the JWT and never a request header; deliberately never called. Retained as the documented anti-pattern; reported in docs/SCALE-TASKS.md.

seed_severity_levels.reason: Superseded by the inline High/Medium/Low seed in 0030; no caller. Retained rather than deleted per BRANCH-MAP; reported in docs/SCALE-TASKS.md.

admin_set_head_level.reason: Sets an org member's Head level (0095). The corrected §2 model (0206) removed the view-only share grant that was its only caller; the Head flag it writes is still read by caller_head_level()/is_head() for signing authority (0096, 0121, 0122, 0123, 0128, 0191), so the setter is retained rather than deleted — an Org Admin path to set it is not built. Reported in docs/SCALE-TASKS.md.

share_covers.reason: Superseded by has_active_share (0095): the universes/entities/engagements select policies use has_active_share, not share_covers. Retained rather than deleted per BRANCH-MAP; reported in docs/SCALE-TASKS.md.

migration_job_advance.reason: Hosting-migration step, granted to service_role only; the migration runner that advances a job is outside this repository.

migration_step_upsert.reason: Hosting-migration step writer, granted to service_role only; the migration runner that records a step is outside this repository.

signing_keys_get.reason: Reads the org's live signing keys (0096). No caller: the IntegrityAnchoringPanel lists authorities and anchors but not keys. Retained rather than deleted per BRANCH-MAP; reported in docs/SCALE-TASKS.md.
